## SGPstateData (development)

* A website built with Quarto at <https://centerforassessment.github.io/SGPstateData/> replaces the old pkgdown pages.
* `scripts/build.R` rebuilds `SGPstateData.rda` from `SGPstateData.R`, which is not changed.
* `scripts/check.R` fails when a fresh build does not reproduce the committed `SGPstateData.rda`, and continuous integration runs it. See [BUILD.md](https://github.com/CenterForAssessment/SGPstateData/blob/master/BUILD.md).

## SGPstateData, September 2017

* First release notes. `SGPstateData` is an R environment embedded in the SGP package; this repository holds its source.
